Description

Thinking of playing rugby at Wallington County Grammar School in South London? Wallington County Grammar School boasts one of the nicest rugby pitches in London so you won’t be disappointed. The excellent playing field, which is available for hire, is the perfect facility to host training sessions, matches and leagues. Clear markings on a very well maintained grass pitch make Wallington County Grammar School an excellent rugby venue. A ball might be able to hire for a small fee from the facility but we advise that you call directly before your arrival to make sure. The pitch is suitable for rugby union, rugby league, tag rugby and touch rugby.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

Looking to set up regular games at Wallington County Grammar School? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest bus stop is Wallington County Grammar School. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.
